name: team_integrate
description: Team cycle (roadmap Phase 2, §4.3 integrate): continuous-rebase integrator (H1, no big-bang merge). Clean deliveries advance to the 'review' state (peer review gates 'done', H13); a fork with no commit (empty_delivery) or a rebase conflict is re-queued as 'reopened' under the attempt cap or terminally 'blocked'; a frozen-contract edit is a controlled event. Releases the wave's file ownership and records each agent's real spend (H5).

sharedBranch.description: The shared branch each wave rebases onto.

dispatched.description: Items dispatched this wave [{id, files, attempt}].

enablePeerReview.description: When true, integrated items go to 'review'; when false, straight to 'done'.

joined.description: The FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC join output, used to record per-agent spend.

sandboxChecks.description: Run the integration check (every integrated item's frozen acceptance tests at the integrated head) OS-sandboxed, as the test cycles do.

reviewing.description: Ids integrated this wave now awaiting peer review.

doneNow.description: Ids marked done directly (peer review disabled).

final_head.description: Shared branch head after this wave.

check.description: The integration check: {state: passed|failed|blocked|skipped, checked: [item ids whose frozen tests ran at final_head], red: {item: failing output tail}, reason}. A red item is re-opened (integration_check_red) with the failure as its directive.
